charge_port.notes: Estimated: The Charge Port US checker lists EC40 (C40 Recharge) 2022-2024 and 2025-2026 as CCS1. Volvo sells a NACS-to-CCS1 adapter for all its EVs (Cision, InsideEVs), which a native NACS port would not need. Canada: same car, same adapter release.

supercharger_access.notes: Volvo Canada release: owners of current fully electric Volvo cars can order a NACS adapter (CA$310) from Nov 18 2024; included with new 2025 EX90/EX40/EC40.
US: $230 adapter via retailers for existing Volvo EV owners; free with 2025 EX90/EX40/EC40.

wheels.notes: C40 Recharge P8 eAWD Ultimate: 20 in aluminum, P235/45HR20 front, P255/40HR20 rear.
